CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: mapeditor remove now warns (doesn't block) when removing a non-last object would shift others down an index while a real damage file already exists -- apps/server restores damage by index, so a shift would silently misattribute damage state; new --damage-file flag; verified live across 4 real scenarios; papercraft_worldobjects.h and NORTHSTAR.md updated (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
